description: Calculate the price for a cosmetic product safety report (CPSR) by product type, number of recipes and varieties, markets, company seat, package and add-ons. Same calculation as the questionnaire on the website. Returns prices per package, what is included, what costs extra, assumptions and a confirmUrl for the user.

claims_review.description: Review of advertising claims per variety (not with claims=no).

eu_representative.description: We act as your responsible person in the EU (only with seat=de or eu, yearly price).

express.description: Report in 5 instead of 10 working days, with a surcharge.

lang.description: Language of the texts in the response and on the confirmation page (default en).

maker.description: Who manufactures the products (does not change the price).

markets.description: Where the products are sold (default EU).

package.description: Package; without it all three are returned with a recommendation.

product_type.description: Product type; several separated by commas, with recipes and varieties in the same order.

recipe_status.description: How far the recipe is (does not change the price).

recipes.description: Own recipes (base formulas) per product type (default 1).

responsible_person.description: Only with seat=non_eu: us = we act as your responsible person in the EU (yearly price), self = you already have one.

seat.description: Seat of the company (default de; determines VAT and the EU representative).

stability_test.description: Stability test in our laboratory (products containing water only).

uk_documents.description: Documents for Great Britain per variety (only with markets=UK).

urgency.description: How urgent it is (does not change the price; faster with express=true).

varieties.description: Total varieties per product type, base products included (e.g. one recipe with three fragrances: recipes=1, varieties=3). Default: same as recipes.

name: get_fixed_price
title: Calculate fixed price
